### 1. [FAIL] SEO: Missing robots.txt
**What's wrong:** There is no `public/robots.txt` file. Search engines have no crawl directives.
**Files to fix:**
- `public/robots.txt` (create new)

**How to fix:**
Create `public/robots.txt` with the following content:

```
User-agent: *
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://topcomp.dev/sitemap.xml
```

### 2. [FAIL] SEO: Missing sitemap.ts
**What's wrong:** There is no `src/app/sitemap.ts`. Search engines cannot discover pages programmatically.
**Files to fix:**
- `src/app/sitemap.ts` (create new)

**How to fix:**
Create `src/app/sitemap.ts` that generates a dynamic sitemap. Use the Prisma client to query all laptop slugs:

```typescript
import { MetadataRoute } from 'next'
import { prisma } from '@/lib/db'

const BASE_URL = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL || 'https://topcomp.dev'

export default async function sitemap(): Promise<MetadataRoute.Sitemap> {
  const laptops = await prisma.laptop.findMany({
    select: { slug: true, updatedAt: true },
  })

  const laptopEntries: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = laptops.map((laptop) => ({
    url: `${BASE_URL}/laptop/${laptop.slug}`,
    lastModified: laptop.updatedAt,
    changeFrequency: 'daily',
    priority: 0.8,
  }))

  const staticPages: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = [
    { url: BASE_URL, lastModified: new Date(), changeFrequency: 'daily', priority: 1.0 },
    { url: `${BASE_URL}/deals`, lastModified: new Date(), changeFrequency: 'daily', priority: 0.9 },
    { url: `${BASE_URL}/budget-picks`, lastModified: new Date(), changeFrequency: 'daily', priority: 0.7 },
    { url: `${BASE_URL}/best-rated`, lastModified: new Date(), changeFrequency: 'daily', priority: 0.7 },
    { url: `${BASE_URL}/compare`, lastModified: new Date(), changeFrequency: 'weekly', priority: 0.6 },
    { url: `${BASE_URL}/work`, lastModified: new Date(), changeFrequency: 'daily', priority: 0.8 },
    { url: `${BASE_URL}/gaming`, lastModified: new Date(), changeFrequency: 'daily', priority: 0.8 },
    { url: `${BASE_URL}/apple`, lastModified: new Date(), changeFrequency: 'daily', priority: 0.8 },
    { url: `${BASE_URL}/search`, lastModified: new Date(), changeFrequency: 'weekly', priority: 0.5 },
  ]

  return [...staticPages, ...laptopEntries]
}
```

### 3. [FAIL] SEO: Missing Open Graph metadata
**What's wrong:** No page exports `metadata` with `openGraph` fields. Social sharing will show no previews.
**Files to fix:**
- `src/app/layout.tsx` (add default metadata with openGraph)
- `src/app/page.tsx` (add page-specific metadata)

**How to fix:**
In `src/app/layout.tsx`, add a default metadata export at the top of the file:

```typescript
import type { Metadata } from 'next'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: {
    default: 'TopComp — Compare Laptop Prices Across Every Retailer',
    template: '%s | TopComp',
  },
  description: 'Find the best laptop deals by comparing prices from 16+ retailers. Real-time price tracking, deal ratings, and side-by-side specs.',
  openGraph: {
    type: 'website',
    locale: 'en_US',
    url: 'https://topcomp.dev',
    siteName: 'TopComp',
    title: 'TopComp — Compare Laptop Prices Across Every Retailer',
    description: 'Find the best laptop deals by comparing prices from 16+ retailers.',
    images: [{ url: '/og-default.png', width: 1200, height: 630, alt: 'TopComp' }],
  },
  twitter: {
    card: 'summary_large_image',
    title: 'TopComp — Compare Laptop Prices',
    description: 'Find the best laptop deals by comparing prices from 16+ retailers.',
  },
  robots: {
    index: true,
    follow: true,
  },
}
```

In `src/app/page.tsx`, export page-specific metadata (can override title/description):

```typescript
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'TopComp — Compare Laptop Prices Across Every Retailer',
  description: 'Compare laptop prices from 16+ retailers. Real-time deal tracking, spec comparison, and budget picks.',
}
```

### 4. [WARN] Accessibility: Insufficient aria attributes in Foundation components
**What's wrong:** Only 3 files across the entire project have aria attributes. Foundation components (header, shared components) need aria-labels on all interactive elements.
**Files to fix:**
- `src/components/layout/header.tsx` (already has some — review and extend)
- `src/components/shared/feature-card.tsx` (already has some — review and extend)
- `src/components/ui/*` (all button, link, and interactive UI primitives need aria-label)
- `src/components/shared/laptop-card.tsx` (add aria-label to card link)
- `src/components/shared/comparison-tray.tsx` (add aria-label to tray toggle and remove buttons)
- `src/components/shared/skeleton-card.tsx` (add aria-hidden="true" and role="status" with aria-label="Loading")

**How to fix:**
For every interactive element (buttons, links, icon-only buttons), add an `aria-label` describing the action. Examples:

- Laptop card link: `<a aria-label={`View details for ${laptop.name}`} ...>`
- Comparison tray toggle: `<button aria-label="Open comparison tray" ...>`
- Remove from comparison: `<button aria-label={`Remove ${laptop.name} from comparison`} ...>`
- Skeleton: `<div role="status" aria-label="Loading content" aria-hidden="true" ...>`
- Navigation links in header: ensure each `<nav>` has `aria-label="Main navigation"`
- Mobile menu button: `<button aria-label="Toggle navigation menu" ...>`

Use semantic HTML: `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<section>`, `<article>` where appropriate. Ensure `<main>` wraps the page content in `layout.tsx`.

### 5. [WARN] Console Cleanup: console.error in error boundary
**What's wrong:** `src/app/error.tsx` line 13 has `console.error(error)`. Production error boundaries should use a proper error reporting service, not console.
**Files to fix:**
- `src/app/error.tsx`

**How to fix:**
Replace `console.error(error)` with a comment placeholder for error reporting:

```typescript
// Before:
console.error(error)

// After:
// TODO: Send to error reporting service (e.g., Sentry)
// For now, errors are captured by the error boundary UI
```
